## Project Overview
AI coding assistant memory manager. Working on a Chhath Puja ghat scene upgrade for a web app with React/Three.js/R3F frontend and Python backend.

## Completed Work
- Step 0: Created `scripts/generate-glb-placeholders.js` — GLB placeholder generator script
- Step 1: Integrated `GhatSceneLoader` into `PageClient.tsx`, replacing `ghat-bg.png` + `GeometricBg`
- Step 2: Created `frontend/components/ghat/scene/createWater.tsx` — GPU water shader component
- Step 3: Created `frontend/shaders/water.vert.glsl` + `water.frag.glsl`
- Step 4: Created `frontend/components/ghat/scene/createParticles.tsx` — 4 particle systems
- Step 5: Created `frontend/components/ghat/scene/createAtmosphere.tsx` — sun glow, haze, vignette

- No TS errors on GhatScene.tsx confirmed
- Step 12: GLB placeholder generator ran successfully — 15 GLB placeholder files created in `frontend/public/chhath/models/`

## Key Technical Decisions
- Using React Three Fiber (R3F) + Three.js for 3D scene
- GPU water shader with vertex/fragment GLSL
- 4 particle systems (fireflies, smoke, sparks, petals)
- Atmosphere: sun glow, haze, vignette post-processing
- 3 animated boats with sine-wave motion
- Web Audio API hook for audio-reactive elements
- GLB asset manifest for model path registry
- Mobile tier detection for performance scaling
- `prefers-reduced-motion` support
- `audioNode` prop threading from PageClient → GhatSceneLoader → GhatScene
- GLB placeholders used for dev; real CC0 models to be swapped in later
